description: This file is a shell script related to Git operations, including tag management, commit creation, and date handling. It contains functions for interacting with Git refs, performing commits, and manipulating date and author information within Git workflows.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies existence of a Git tag and retrieves its SHA1 hash.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Creates a unique commit using specified text, tree, and additional arguments.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Updates a Git tag's reference and modifies a sed script to replace unhelpful SHA1 hashes.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Transforms hashes to symbolic names by applying sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Executes a command with a specified GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, restoring original afterwards.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Extracts the commit date (timestamp) from a given commit SHA.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date to a variable, handling various input formats.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Sets GIT_COMMITTER_DATE to a fake date for the duration of a command.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Sets both GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and GIT_AUTHOR_DATE to fake dates for a command.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Runs a command, suppressing its error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs a command and compares its output to an expected value.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Generates a sanitized name from a description string, suitable for use as a test name.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Defines and runs a test expecting a specific output, using the provided description and command.
